historical_references.reference: Ramsundar was a prominent Hindu leader during the British colonial rule in Bengal. He was a key figure in the Non-Cooperation Movement of 1920, which was led by Mahatma Gandhi to protest against the Rowlatt Act. Ramsundar was also known for his leadership in the Kalighat temple agitation of 1921, where he led a march of over 100,000 people demanding the right to manage the temple.
